title: Economic Survey 2025-26 - UPSC Practice MCQs
source: Economic Survey 2025-26 Highlights, Department of Economic Affairs, GoI

questions.question: As per the Economic Survey 2025-26, India's real GDP growth for FY27 is projected in which range?
questions.explanation: The Survey projects FY27 real GDP growth at 6.8–7.2%, continuing India's strong growth momentum.

questions.question: Which THREE factors does the Survey identify as pushing India's potential GDP growth to ~7% ('Reform Express')?

options.A: Capital Accumulation, Labour Input, Total Factor Productivity
options.C: Fiscal Deficit, Current Account Deficit, Inflation

questions.explanation: The Survey's growth framework rests on capital accumulation, labour input (formalisation/skilling) and total factor productivity.

questions.question: The Union Government's fiscal deficit target for FY26 (Budget Estimate) is:
questions.explanation: FY26 BE fiscal deficit is pegged at 4.4% of GDP, continuing the consolidation path from 9.2% in FY21.

questions.question: Which of the following agencies upgraded India's sovereign credit rating in 2025, as noted in the Survey?

options.B: Morningstar DBRS, S&P Global Ratings, R&I (Japan)

questions.explanation: The Survey attributes 2025 sovereign rating upgrades to Morningstar DBRS, S&P Global Ratings, and R&I of Japan.

questions.question: Under GST 2.0 reforms, the new two-rate structure comprises which rates (besides the de-merit/sin-good rate)?
questions.explanation: GST 2.0 introduced a simplified two-rate structure of 5% (merit) and 18% (standard), with a 40% rate for de-merit/sin goods.

questions.question: India's Current Account Deficit (CAD) in H1 FY26 stood at approximately:
questions.explanation: CAD moderated to 0.8% of GDP in H1 FY26 from 1.3% in H1 FY25, reflecting a comfortable external position.

questions.question: As per UNCTAD data cited in the Survey, India was the world's largest destination for greenfield digital investment (2020-2024), attracting approximately:
questions.explanation: India attracted USD 114 billion in greenfield digital investment (2020-2024), the highest globally, ahead of Malaysia and Indonesia.

questions.question: Which of the following Free Trade Agreements has India concluded (signed) in the last five years?
questions.explanation: The India-UK CETA (2025) is among the 8 FTAs/CEPAs concluded in the past 5 years. The others listed are still under negotiation.

questions.question: According to the Survey, India's average headline CPI inflation for April-December 2025 was the lowest since the CPI series began, at approximately:
questions.explanation: April-Dec 2025 average headline inflation was 1.7%, the lowest since the CPI series began, driven by subdued food inflation.

questions.question: Among Agriculture sub-sectors, which recorded the HIGHEST average GVA growth during FY20-FY24?
questions.explanation: Fishing and Aquaculture grew fastest at 7.2% (FY20-FY24 average), ahead of Livestock (6.1%) and Crop (4.0%).

questions.question: India's Services GVA growth in 2024, as highlighted in the Survey's cross-country comparison, was:
questions.explanation: India's Services GVA grew 7.2% in 2024, well above the World (2.8%), US (1.3%), EU (2.2%) and UK (2.1%).

questions.question: Medium- and high-technology activities account for what share of India's total manufacturing value added?
questions.explanation: The Survey notes medium- and high-tech activities now account for 46.3% of India's total manufacturing value added.

questions.question: India's rank in the Global Innovation Index improved from 81 (2015) to which position in 2025?
questions.explanation: India's Global Innovation Index rank improved steadily from 81 (2015) to 38 (2025), per WIPO data cited in the Survey.

questions.question: The National Nuclear Energy Mission (2025-26) targets what nuclear capacity by 2047?
questions.explanation: The Mission targets 100 GW of nuclear capacity by 2047, up from the current 8,780 MW, with Rs. 20,000 crore allocated in Budget 2025-26.

questions.question: The SHANTI Act, enacted in December 2025, primarily relates to:

options.A: Enabling private and state participation in nuclear power with a graded liability framework
options.B: Reforming labour laws for gig workers

questions.explanation: The SHANTI Act enables private and state participation in nuclear energy, introduces a graded liability framework and protects victim compensation.

questions.question: As per NEP 2020 targets cited in the Survey, India aims to achieve 100% Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in school education by:
questions.explanation: The Survey notes NEP's target of achieving 100% GER in school education by 2030, and 50% GER in higher education by 2035.

questions.question: The four Labour Codes (consolidating 29 labour laws) were enacted on:
questions.explanation: The four Labour Codes — Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security, and Occupational Safety, Health & Working Conditions — were enacted on 21 November 2025.

questions.question: Female Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) in India rose from 23.3% (2017-18) to what level in 2023-24 (Annual PLFS)?
questions.explanation: Female LFPR rose sharply from 23.3% (2017-18) to 41.7% (2023-24), while female unemployment fell from 5.6% to 3.2%.

questions.question: As per the revised World Bank international poverty line (USD 3.0/day), India's extreme poverty rate in 2022-23 was:
questions.explanation: India's extreme poverty rate fell to 5.3% in 2022-23 as per the revised international poverty line of USD 3.0/day.

questions.question: Which city is cited in the Survey as a model for India's cleanest-city waste management practices?
questions.explanation: Indore is highlighted as India's cleanest city, attributed to strict penalties, leadership buy-in, and sustained civic-sense campaigns.
